==Description==
'''Papa Bread''' appeared exclusively in [[Village of Despair]] as part of the [[Christmas 2019 Event]].

'''Papa Bread''' was a gingerbread with the ability to summon [[Present (Village of Despair)|Present]]s. Unlike the [[Gingerbread (Village of Despair)|Gingerbread]] and [[Burnt Gingerbread]], this enemy cannot stun towers. While it has the same walkspeed as the [[Deep Freeze (Village of Despair)|Deep Freeze]], it has lower health than it.

==Appearance==
'''Papa Bread''' had a similar appearance to the [[Gingerbread (Village of Despair)|Gingerbread]], with a gingerbread-like appearance. It wore a Christmas Coat, a belt, a Santa hat and a beard. It had glowing red eyes. It wielded a candy cane to spawn [[Present (Village of Despair)|Present]]s.

==Strategy==
*[[Freezer]]'s and [[Frost Blaster]]'s can freeze '''Papa Bread''', leaving you with more time to kill it.
*The [[Rocketeer]] and [[Mortar]] can be useful against '''Papa Bread''', but not towards the [[Present (Village of Despair)|Present]] that it spawns as it is immune to splash damage.
*This must be killed quite quickly or large numbers of [[Present (Village of Despair)|Present]]s will likely overwhelm you.
**It is unlikely that towers targeting ''Strongest'' or even ''Last'' will target '''Papa Bread''' due to the presence of the [[Deep Freeze (Village of Despair)|Deep Freeze]].
*Due to explosive towers having no effect on '''Papa Bread's''' [[Present (Village of Despair)|Presents]] that it spawns, it is recommended to get high DPS Towers that can get rid of said [[Present (Krampus Frosthold)|Presents]] quickly, such as the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] and [[Minigunner]] against '''Papa Bread'''.

==Trivia==
*'''Papa Bread's''' name and appearance bears a slight resemblance to [[w:c:r2da:Papa G.|Papa G.]] from ''R2DA''.
**The coat that '''Papa Bread''' wears is the [[w:c:r2da:Christmas Coat|Christmas Coat]] from ''R2DA''.
